Treatment summary
Patient presented folloiwng a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The reported injury is
consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over the course of twelve visits, care followed a typical conservative
pathway that included manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Range of motion was limited on initial
examination, with paraspinal muscle tenderness noted on palpation, while neurological screening and reflex testing remained
within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit
frequency was reduced as function returned, with discharge planned once the patient reached expected recovery milestones. Note
that two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service are currently under review for accuracy. Prognosis is good
with continued self-management.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
